business_purpose: Compare three evidence-backed visual directions for /v2/home so the owner can choose a coherent aesthetic and information hierarchy before any production UI code changes.
raw_data_boundary: No raw merchant files, buyer data, order rows, addresses, phone numbers, or after-sales details are used. The concepts use clearly marked masked demonstration values based only on the approved 17-metric contract.
decision_questions: Can the owner identify the current operating state within 10 seconds?
Can the owner find the most important gap and its supporting metric within 30 seconds?
Can the owner distinguish operating performance from data-health status without exposing raw data?
Which visual direction best expresses Airburg as quiet, precise, trustworthy, and commercially useful?

allowed: Three comparable desktop and mobile directions
Masked demonstration values and contract-approved metric names
Design tokens, state matrix, annotations, screenshots, and human-selection handoff
forbidden: ETL, BI, Target, persistence, metric formula, or route changes
Hiding or removing any of the 17 KPI by default
Deployment, push, or replacement of legacy /home
Claiming VISUAL_ACCEPTED or HUMAN_ACCEPTED from generated concepts

unknowns: Final Airburg logo asset and formal brand color specification are not yet provided.
The owner has not yet selected one of the three visual directions.
The concepts have not yet been compared against an approved Figma master.
Normal-state values are masked demonstration data and are not business evidence.
validation_plan: Render and inspect all three directions at desktop and mobile widths.
Confirm all 17 KPI labels remain present and unavailable metrics display --.
Confirm no NaN, Infinity, undefined, rawRows, previewRows, order number, phone, address, or buyer note appears.
Confirm the comparison control changes the active direction and first render is useful.
Keep visualAccepted=false, humanAccepted=false, and humanReviewRequired=true until explicit owner selection.
